adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `poll_feed` iterates `rss.items.each` and calls `TopicEmbed.import(...)` with no per-item error handling. Since `TopicEmbed.import` can raise (e.g., `TopicEmbed.create!` under the unique `embed_url` index can throw `ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique` in a race; DB/validation errors can also bubble), a single bad item will abort the job and prevent subsequent items in the feed from being processed for that run. Because the scheduled job has `sidekiq_options retry: false`, failures won’t be retried automatically, and if the same poisoned item remains in the feed, later items can be skipped on every run until it’s removed.
